cause: A server recommendation validation error after a typed Notebook submission escaped the Agent correction loop as a generic NOTEBOOK_REQUEST_INVALID route error.

evidence.ref: tests/test_notebook_planning_agent.py::test_provider_corrects_a_server_recommendation_validation_error passed after a first server rejection issued one bounded correction and the next typed submission was accepted; the subsequent real Notebook retry proposed 7 options.

impact: Server recommendation validation now participates in the bounded correction loop, and the real C2 retry returned a persisted option batch rather than a generic request error.
lesson: Server-side option and recommendation validation must re-enter the same bounded correction policy as a typed provider submission instead of being relabeled as a route request error.
